New native default certificates use Organization MytelPBX - Mytel.one and SANs for the validated native FQDN plus at most sixteen distinct valid global-scope assigned IPv4 addresses, including private LAN addresses. No DNS/network lookup, certificate/key/service action during transformation, new dependency or TLS bypass. The original EKU generation guard, RSA2048, SHA256, 824-day lifetime, serial policy, certificate/key paths, native call order and httpd restart remain unchanged. Already configured/custom certificate behavior is preserved by the unchanged native guard.
